findings.finding: At last year's finals management called Q1 strong yet 'prudent to maintain current market expectations' and the stock fell 2.75%, upgrading only at a separate 9 Dec trading update (+10.1%); this year the stock has run from 264.5p (5 Oct) to 314p (13 Nov, +3.3% on the day) into a release whose guide was already reset in August.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guide held at results: Nov 2025 finals -2.75%, Mar 2026 interims -7.24%; guide raised at standalone TUs: Aug 2025 +11.9%, Dec 2025 +10.1%, Jun 2026 +11.7%.
findings.original_quote: Despite a strong Q1 FY26, given that the financial year is still at an early stage, the Board believes it is prudent to maintain current market expectations for FY26
findings.why_not_priced: The run-up into the print (+18.7% off the 5 Oct low, +7.7% over 20 sessions, +4.15% over 5) says holders are positioned for good current-trading news; if the market expected this management's usual early-year caution the stock would not have recovered fully above the 275p placing and back to its 26 Aug level (316.5p). It is a reaction-pattern inference, so it is sized small.

findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The whey warning arrived with the 26 Aug raise and the stock moved -1.56% that day; Mar 2026 interims fell 7.24%.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the company already guided margin down for whey and City AM led on it (https://www.cityam.com/whey-and-weight-loss-drugs-to-eat-into-applied-nutrition-profit/, 2026-08-26). findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: FY25 finals reported 72.4% FCF conversion and the stock still fell 2.75%; no prior APN print has carried weak cash conversion.
findings.original_quote: Net cash (excluding IFRS 16 liabilities) at the close of FY26 was £15.9m, following the acquisition of the trade and assets of Nutrablend, capital expenditure on the production extension and increased working capital to support growth.
findings.why_not_priced: The net-cash figure is public but the split between working capital, capex and the acquisition is not, and no wire piece found discussed conversion; the 26 Aug coverage led on whey and the guide, not cash. Largely an arithmetic inference from two public numbers, so small.
